name: For Better or Worse
source:
MC is betrothed to her parents' colleagues' son, Ethan Jackson. Both have been promised to each other since birth, and have agreed to the conditions in order to uphold family honor and reputation. Neither have ever seen each other in person but they know of the other. The wedding date was meant to be when the children turned 25 but had to be rushed a few years earlier because of the parents' business issues and the accident -- the accident that left her blind. Ever since that day, she has learned braille and become close friends with a pen pal, one who was also willing to learn braille in order to understand MC. 

Will her and Ethan's marriage turn out to be "for better or worse?" Or does she love the one stranger that she has only communicated with through paper?

[From [url=https://anomalis-games.itch.io/for-better-or-worse]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
女主角与父母同事的儿子伊桑·杰克逊订有婚约。两人从出生起，便被许配给彼此。为了维护家族的荣誉与声望，他们都接受了这一安排。虽然从未真正见面，却知道对方的存在。婚礼原定在两人25岁时举行，但由于父母的生意问题，以及那场让她失明的意外，婚期不得不提前几年。自那天起，她学会了盲文，也与一位笔友成为亲密的朋友。为了理解女主角，对方同样愿意学习盲文。

她与伊桑的婚姻最终会是更好，还是更坏？又或者，她真正爱上的是那个始终只通过纸笔交流的陌生人？

[摘自[url=https://anomalis-games.itch.io/for-better-or-worse]itch.io[/url]]
